title: Law to ban ads for unregistered e-bikes and scooters
summary: This bill would prohibit businesses from advertising for sale, lease, rent or distribution any vehicle that must be registered with the state Department of Motor Vehicles as an e-bike or powered mobility device. Ads for vehicles that look like e-bikes or scooters but require DMV registration must clearly say so. It also requires city agencies to develop informational materials for retailers and run a public outreach campaign about authorized devices and the risks of unregistered ones, with the law taking effect 180 days after enactment.
